items.distractor_fact: Дигиталният термометър в кухнята показал {D} °C същата сутрин.
items.gloss_en: The digital kitchen thermometer showed {D} °C that same morning.
items.entity_note: Different owner kind: a household instrument (the kitchen thermometer), not a place as in the first distractor (a neighboring village's thermometer); the unit symbol °C never inflects after a numeral.

items.distractor_fact: Един инвеститор притежавал акции на друга компания на стойност {D} $.
items.gloss_en: An investor owned shares of another company worth {D} $.
items.entity_note: Different owner kind: an individual person (the investor), not an organisation as in the first distractor (another company); the unit symbol $ never inflects after a numeral.

items.distractor_fact: По същото време друг турист от съседна група се намирал на височина {D} м.
items.gloss_en: At the same time, another hiker from a nearby group was at an altitude of {D} m.
items.entity_note: Different owner kind: a person (another hiker), not a place as in the first distractor (a neighboring ridge's peak); the unit symbol м never inflects after a numeral.

items.distractor_fact: Друг отбор, тренирал на същия лагер, имал среден състав с тегло от {D} кг.
items.gloss_en: Another team training at the same camp had an average roster weight of {D} kg.
items.entity_note: Different owner kind: an organisation (another team), not a single person as in the first distractor (another athlete); the unit symbol кг never inflects after a numeral.

items.distractor_fact: Друг клон на банката управлявал бизнес сметка с наличност от {D} €.
items.gloss_en: Another branch of the bank managed a business account with a balance of {D} €.
items.entity_note: Different owner kind: an organisation (a bank branch), not a person as in the first distractor (another customer); the unit symbol € never inflects after a numeral.

items.distractor_fact: Друга банка в същия град отчела депозити от {D} $ през годината.
items.gloss_en: Another bank in the same town recorded deposits of {D} $ during the year.
items.entity_note: Different owner kind: a separate financial organisation (another bank), not an individual account as in the first distractor (a different savings account); the unit symbol $ never inflects after a numeral.

items.distractor_fact: Хотелът, в който семейството отседнало, предлагал специална програма на стойност {D} лв за други гости.
items.gloss_en: The hotel where the family stayed offered other guests a special package worth {D} lev.
items.entity_note: Different owner kind: an organisation (the hotel), not a family/person group as in the first distractor (another family); the unit лв never inflects after a numeral.

items.distractor_fact: Собственикът на друг магазин на същата улица отчел лична печалба от {D} $ през месеца.
items.gloss_en: The owner of another shop on the same street reported a personal profit of {D} $ during the month.
items.entity_note: Different owner kind: an individual person (the shop owner), not an organisation as in the first distractor (another company); the unit symbol $ never inflects after a numeral.

items.distractor_fact: Голмайсторът на друг отбор вкарал {D} гола през шампионата.
items.gloss_en: The top scorer of another team scored {D} goals during the championship.
items.entity_note: Different owner kind: an individual person (a player), not an organisation as in the first distractor (another team); 'гола' is the invariant counting form after any numeral.

items.distractor_fact: Друг инвеститор реализирал печалба от {D} $ през същия период.
items.gloss_en: Another investor realized a profit of {D} $ during the same period.
items.entity_note: Different owner kind: an individual person (an investor), not an organisation as in the first distractor (another fund); the unit symbol $ never inflects after a numeral.

items.distractor_fact: Автоматизираната поточна линия в завод в друг град произвела {D} бройки през месеца.
items.gloss_en: The automated production line at a factory in another town produced {D} units during the month.
items.entity_note: Shared-reference domain: different owner kind, a piece of equipment (an automated production line at an unrelated factory), not an organisation as in the first distractor (another factory in the same holding); that line's own target is never stated, so it cannot be paired with the story's plan; 'бройки' is invariant after any numeral.

items.distractor_fact: Личният дъждомер на фермер в съседно село отчел {D} мм валежи през същата седмица.
items.gloss_en: A farmer's personal rain gauge in a neighboring village recorded {D} mm of rainfall during the same week.
items.entity_note: Shared-reference domain: different owner kind, a person (a farmer with his own gauge), not an instrument/station as in the first distractor (another weather station); his own forecast is never stated, so it cannot be paired with the story's forecast; the unit symbol мм never inflects after a numeral.

items.distractor_fact: Голф клубът, организатор на турнира, обявил среден резултат на любителите за деня от {D} удара.
items.gloss_en: The golf club organizing the tournament announced an average amateur score for the day of {D} strokes.
items.entity_note: Shared-reference domain: different owner kind, an organisation (the golf club's aggregate figure), not a person as in the first distractor (another player); that amateur average carries no stated par of its own, so it cannot be paired with the story's par; 'удара' is the invariant counting form after any numeral.

items.distractor_fact: Голф федерацията отчела национален среден резултат от {D} удара за сезона.
items.gloss_en: The golf federation recorded a national average score of {D} strokes for the season.
items.entity_note: Shared-reference domain: different owner kind, an organisation (the golf federation), not a person as in the first distractor (another golfer on another course); the federation's national average carries no stated total par of its own; 'удара' is invariant after any numeral.

items.distractor_fact: Диспечерската служба на друга железопътна компания отчела просрочие от {D} мин за свой влак.
items.gloss_en: The dispatch service of another railway company recorded a delay of {D} min for its own train.
items.entity_note: Shared-reference domain: different owner kind, an organisation (another company's dispatch service), not an instrument as in the first distractor (a different train on a different line); its own schedule is never stated, so it cannot be paired with the story's schedule; 'мин' never inflects after a numeral.

items.distractor_fact: Офисът на архитектурното бюро, проектирало сградата, се намира в друга сграда на етаж с обозначение {D}.
items.gloss_en: The office of the architecture firm that designed the building is located in a different building on a floor designated {D}.
items.entity_note: Shared-reference domain: different owner kind, an organisation (the architecture firm's office), not a place/apartment as in the first distractor (an apartment in a neighboring building); that building's own ground floor is never stated; the bare numeral after 'с обозначение' stays grammatical for any integer.
